title: Explicit GLIMPSE2 Operations from R
text: current deterministic phase contract requires threads = 1L. Parallelize across independent chunks rather inside phase child: low-pass whole-genome sequencing, phase executable can call SNP likelihoods directly one coordinate-sorted BAM CRAM. Supply alignment index explicitly; must use adjacent name HTSlib can discover. CRAM also requires reference FASTA adjacent .fai. default calls likelihoods SNPs keeps flat likelihoods indels. Set call_indels = TRUE GLIMPSE2 indel calling model intended. writing ordered file containing one absolute phase-output path per line, ligate chunks: Successful operations return RGlimpse2RunResult.
